purpose: Teach: 破り/亡くし/狙わ/荒らし/号泣/繋がら/縫っ/映り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の慣行を破り、新規参入、果たすぞ。
lines.en: We'll break industry convention and make this new entry work.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Deliberate pace on each clause. No wasted breath. The tone of someone laying down the mission once, clearly, expecting it to be understood and executed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者を亡くした企業、再建中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're rebuilding the company after losing its founder.
lines.style: Clipped, professional. Each statement lands with quiet confidence. Respectful of the gravity but not dwelling on it. The tone of someone reporting progress without seeking sympathy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合に狙われる商品、特許で守れ。
lines.en: The products our competitors are after — protect them with patents.
lines.style: Imperative but not harsh. Leans forward slightly in the delivery. The pace quickens on 「守れ」 — precision matters here. Expecting immediate comprehension and action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫を荒らした事案、警察と連携します。
lines.en: Yes. The warehouse break-in — we're coordinating with the police.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, handling multiple threads. Slightly faster tempo. Shows he's already ahead on this. Not seeking approval, reporting completed groundwork.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 号泣する社員、心理面のケア、忘れるな。
lines.en: The staff members who are struggling — don't overlook their mental health support.
lines.style: Softer undercurrent. The voice drops slightly on 「心理面のケア」. This is not a directive about profit — it's about people. Weight but not coldness. The reminder of someone who understands that business rests on humans.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外と繋がらない部署、IT支援、入れます。
lines.en: Yes. For the teams isolated from our overseas operations, I'm bringing in IT support.
lines.style: Assured, moving forward. Slightly warmer tone than previous responses. Shows he's absorbed the broader context — not just logistics, but inclusion. Steady confidence without complacency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトを縫って組み立てる手腕、評価する。
lines.en: The way you're weaving these pieces together — I see that skill.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment. Slight pause before 「評価する」. Not effusive, but genuine. The tone of a leader who gives praise when it's earned and means it. Respectful, not patronizing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。メディアに映り込む形で、ブランド、強化します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen the brand through our media visibility.
lines.style: Grounded, planning ahead. Steady pulse. Shows he's thinking beyond immediate recovery — toward future position. Respectfully ends the exchange without over-explaining. Efficient, confident close.
